title: /clear leaves ccx painting a completely blank screen until the next keystroke
ccx: Entire 120x40 pane blank — no banner, no composer, no footer, no scrollback (capture-pane -S -50 empty). Process alive (pane_dead=0). Only after sending a single character 'X' does the composer+footer repaint. frames-qa5/qa5-ccx-after-clear.txt vs qa5-ccx-clearblank-then-key.txt
claude: Repaints the full welcome box (v2.1.222 banner, Welcome back, model, cwd, What's new), transcript wiped, composer and footer present immediately. frames-qa5/qa5-cc-after-clear.txt
suspects: harness/src/tui clear handler — new-session state built but no forced full repaint

title: /rename and /tag answer 'no session yet — send a first prompt' even after completed turns

suspects: the rename/tag handlers read a fleet/detachable session handle that a foreground REPL never populates

claude: Rewind panel lists '/resume 2bceb032-… (previous session)', '/compact', then each post-clear turn. frames-qa5/qa5-cc-rewind-postclear.txt

title: Rewind replays the UNTRIMMED transcript — turns that were dropped from engine context stay on screen
repro: Up Up to select 'Reply with exactly: TWO'
ccx: Replay shows '⏪ rewound: 246543f0 · 3 turns' then ONE, TWO, THREE, then '⏪ rewound here · live'. Engine context IS correctly trimmed (asked it to list every word requested → answered 'ONE' only) and /export writes a correctly trimmed markdown file, so the transcript display alone is wrong. Old scrollback IS wiped (capture-pane -S -100 shows only the replayed block). frames-qa5/qa5-ccx2-after-rewind.txt

suspects: rewind replay feeds the pre-rewind transcript document instead of the trimmed one

title: --resume rejects the 8-char short id that ccx itself prints everywhere
ccx: '⚠ couldn't resume 246543f0 — no history found' then silently falls through to a fresh REPL. The same session resumes correctly with the full UUID (--resume 246543f0-058e-4ce4-bfdb-4806881a5846 → replays the transcript + '─── resumed here · live ───'). ccx prints short ids in the detachable banner ('backgrounded · c31cc0df') and in the rewind divider ('⏪ rewound: 246543f0'), so the id a user copies is the one --resume refuses.
claude: claude --resume <id> accepts the id shown in /status (full uuid); no short-id surface exists to conflict
